detail.request: Let readers save articles to read later — a "Saved" page listing what they saved, and a save/unsave control that can go on an article. Store each save as a SavedArticle record with userId and articleId (the Contentful id, same as we do for ratings) — I do not want a second way of identifying an article appearing later, so make sure that decision is written down where the next person will find it.

operations.intent: Logic component with in: [Do, articleId, userId] out: [Failure, Success] that creates/deletes a SavedArticle record keyed by userId and the Contentful articleId (same identifier used for ratings), toggling save state.

Logic component with in: [Do, userId] out: [Failure, Success, savedArticles] that queries all SavedArticle records for the given userId and returns the list of articleIds/article data for rendering the Saved page.

A visual save/unsave toggle control with in: [articleId, userId, isSaved] out: [Toggled] that shows saved state and emits an event when clicked; to be placed on the Article page/component, invoking Save Article logic component.

A new page that on mount calls Logic Components/Get Saved Articles with the current userId, and lists saved articles (using Contentful articleId to fetch/display each article, e.g. via Get Article From Slug or similar), each with a Save Button to unsave.
Add the Save Button component (in: articleId, userId, isSaved) near the article content so readers can save/unsave the currently viewed article, wired to Logic Components/Save Article.
Add navigation/routing entry to the new Pages/Saved (e.g. a 'Saved' link/route in the app's navigation) so readers can reach their saved articles list.

Document the new Pages/Saved route, the SavedArticle data model (userId + Contentful articleId), and explicitly record that articleId (Contentful id) is the single canonical identifier for articles across ratings and saves, to prevent a second identifier scheme from emerging.

stagedDoc.summary: Documented the new Saved page and codified articleId (Contentful id) as the single canonical article identifier across ratings and saves.
